helper_tasks.task: Using the attached fresh-study records only, assess one minimal explanatory repair conditional on the selected root contrast eventually receiving independent acceptance as a counterexample. Distinguish observed evidence from proposed mechanism. Investigate whether transient sheet evolution or upstream geometry can support a quantitative prediction without assuming a stationary Sweet–Parker sheet. Specify a frozen formula predicting rates or crossing durations at new resistivity settings, calibration inputs and parameter values or an explicit procedure for fixing them before validation, numerical allowances, and a quantitative falsifier. Select affordable independent settings prospectively, explain what field diagnostics would challenge the mechanism, and estimate costs from recorded completed trajectories. Do not present a fitted exponent band or an identity using validation-measured current as an explanatory prediction. If the available evidence cannot identify a defensible predictive repair, explain the missing information and propose the smallest discriminating diagnostic. No solver changes, simulations, imports from earlier studies, or scientific approvals.
helper_tasks.completion_criteria: Deliver one bounded conditional proposal with explicit mechanism/evidence separation, a prospectively freezable prediction, independent validation cases, quantitative failure criteria, diagnostic requirements and a budget estimate. Clearly identify unsupported assumptions and whether additional calibration is required before commitment.
